data.explanation: This is a service invoice, not an official letter, so there is no legal remedy procedure. You should pay the full €321.30 to the IBAN shown within the stated period after you received the invoice; the app will show the exact due date. If you keep the invoice, you may be able to deduct part of the cost (garden and craftsman work) on your German tax return — consider asking a tax advisor if unsure. If you don't pay, the provider may send a reminder or charge late fees, though none are mentioned here.
